description: This file defines the BlockingCounter class in the Abseil synchronization library, which provides thread synchronization primitives for blocking until a certain number of actions are completed.

classes.name: BlockingCounter
classes.description: A class that allows a thread to block until a specified number of events have occurred, with methods to decrement the count and wait for completion.

methods.name: BlockingCounter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the counter with a specified initial count.

methods.name: DecrementCount
methods.description: Decrements the internal count by one and returns true if the count reaches zero.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Blocks the calling thread until the internal count reaches zero.
